name: Maya
aboutMe: I teach high-school math and run before sunrise so my head is clear. Not into nightlife or small talk; I’d rather cook for two and watch a documentary. I read a lot of history and keep a small balcony garden. Financially I save first, spend on books and one good trip a year.
aboutPartner: Someone who doesn’t need to be entertained every evening. A good listener, okay with silence. Values honesty over smoothness.
aboutRelationship: Slow and steady. I need trust and space; I’m not into grand gestures. Prefer building something real over chasing excitement.

name: Oren
aboutMe: Software architect, remote. I’ve lived in three countries in five years and like not being tied to one place. I meditate, don’t eat meat, and care about sustainability. Money is a tool for freedom, not status.
aboutPartner: Curious, adaptable, fine with plans changing. Doesn’t need a white-picket future.
aboutRelationship: Partners in adventure. I’m not looking for someone to settle down with in the classic sense—more to grow and explore with, with or without a fixed address.

name: Noa
aboutMe: Nurse. I like routine: same gym, same coffee place, same people. Big family, we do Friday dinners every week. I’m practical and not very spiritual; I believe in what I can see and do.
aboutPartner: Stable, kind, family-minded. Someone who shows up.
aboutRelationship: Clear and committed. I want a life partner, kids eventually, a home. Not into drama or guessing games.

name: Yoni
aboutMe: I fix industrial printers and build furniture in my shed. Introvert; social stuff drains me. I’d rather have one deep conversation than a party. I don’t follow trends and I’m careful with money.
aboutPartner: Someone who gets that I need alone time. Patient, genuine, not into performance.
aboutRelationship: Quiet partnership. Quality time at home, shared projects, mutual respect. No pressure to be someone I’m not.

name: Tamar
aboutMe: CFO at a mid-size company. I’m ambitious and rational; I don’t do vibes, I do spreadsheets and long-term plans. I work out, read non-fiction, and travel for work. Not spiritual; I trust data and contracts.
aboutPartner: Smart, driven, direct. Someone who can debate without taking it personally.
aboutRelationship: Equal partnership. Clear expectations, shared goals, no mind-reading. I’m in it for the long run if we’re aligned.

name: Eitan
aboutMe: Personal trainer. I’m loud, I love people, and I get energy from groups. I spend on experiences and gear; I’m not a saver. Live for the moment.
aboutPartner: Fun, outgoing, up for spontaneity. Someone who doesn’t overthink.
aboutRelationship: Lots of laughter and doing things together. I need someone who matches my energy and doesn’t clip my wings.

name: Rivka
aboutMe: I work in a kindergarten and volunteer with elderly. Family is everything; I want a big table full of kids and holidays together. I’m traditional in values, modern in daily life. I save for a house and don’t chase brands.
aboutPartner: Serious about family, reliable, same values. Someone who wants to build a home.
aboutRelationship: Marriage and children. I want a real partnership, shared faith and goals, and a stable home.

name: Dan
aboutMe: Ex-startup, now consulting. I’ve had phases: minimalist, then investor, now I care more about time than money. I run, read philosophy, and prefer small circles.
aboutPartner: Thoughtful, not clingy. Someone who has their own thing going.
aboutRelationship: Two whole people choosing each other. Independence plus intimacy. No merging; we add to each other.

name: Shira
aboutMe: Dive instructor. I live in flip-flops, love the sea and sun. I’m not a planner; I go where the season takes me. I’m spiritual in a loose way—nature and ocean feel sacred.
aboutPartner: Easygoing, loves outdoors, doesn’t need a rigid plan.
aboutRelationship: Free and fun. Maybe we stay here, maybe we move. I’m open as long as it feels right.

name: Avi
aboutMe: Dentist, own practice. I like order: same schedule, same restaurant, same holiday spot. I’m not into risk; I invest carefully and save. Family man at heart.
aboutPartner: Stable, warm, wants kids and a calm life.
aboutRelationship: Classic long-term. House, kids, holidays, growing old together. I’m ready when you are.

name: Lior
aboutMe: I’m a freelance illustrator. I work from home, odd hours, and I need lots of alone time to create. I’m not spiritual; I just like making things. I spend on tools and good coffee, save the rest.
aboutPartner: Someone who respects my need for space and quiet. Creative or at least understanding of it.
aboutRelationship: Together but separate. We support each other without suffocating. Art and life both need room.

name: Michal
aboutMe: Social worker. I’ve seen a lot of mess; it made me value stability and kindness. I’m an introvert who can turn it on at work. I like hiking, reading, and simple weekends.
aboutPartner: Empathetic, steady, not into drama. Someone who does the small things.
aboutRelationship: Safe and supportive. I want to come home to peace, not chaos. We build trust day by day.

name: Guy
aboutMe: Sales. I love meeting people and closing deals. I like nice things and don’t mind spending. Not super rational about money—I work hard and enjoy it.
aboutPartner: Sociable, positive, likes to go out.
aboutRelationship: Fun and forward-moving. I want a partner who’s also a best friend and up for adventures.

name: Natalie
aboutMe: Yoga teacher and part-time waitress. I meditate, do retreats, and believe in energy and intention. I live simply and don’t care much about money beyond basics.
aboutRelationship: Deep connection. I want someone to grow with, not just share a couch. Spirit and heart matter.

name: Roi
aboutMe: Engineer, nine-to-five. I game, cook, and hang with a small group. I’m not nomadic or spiritual; I like predictability and logic.
aboutPartner: Similar vibe. Chill, loyal, no games.
aboutRelationship: Steady and transparent. We know what we want and we work toward it together.

name: Adi
aboutMe: I run a small import business and travel for work a lot. I love airports and new places. I’m rational about money but spend on travel. Not really spiritual.
aboutPartner: Independent, okay with me being away sometimes. Curious about the world.
aboutRelationship: Partners who don’t need to be glued together. Trust and adventure. Maybe we relocate one day.

name: Ella
aboutMe: Student and barista. I’m saving for a trip and don’t know what comes after. I like concerts, friends, and not planning too far ahead.
aboutPartner: Fun, flexible, not pressuring for serious plans yet.
aboutRelationship: See where it goes. I’m open to something real but not in a rush.

name: Amir
aboutMe: High-school teacher. I read, garden, and value deep talks. I’m an introvert with a strong moral compass. I save and give to causes I care about.
aboutPartner: Thoughtful, kind, similar values. Someone who likes substance.
aboutRelationship: Meaningful and lasting. I want a teammate for life, with shared values and quiet strength.

name: Yael
aboutMe: Marketing manager. I’m outgoing at work but need downtime after. I like good food, design, and one or two close friends. I’m practical and not very spiritual.
aboutPartner: Balanced: social but not needy. Smart and grounded.
aboutRelationship: Adult partnership. We have our own lives and a strong us. No drama, clear communication.

name: Ido
aboutMe: Med student. I’m busy, stressed, and future-focused. I don’t have much time for spirituality or travel. I want stability later.
aboutPartner: Understanding of my schedule. Patient, supportive.
aboutRelationship: Someone to build a future with. Not now, but I’m looking for the right person for the long run.

name: Ronit
aboutMe: I’ve been a journalist for twenty years. I’ve lived in four countries, speak three languages, and my friends are scattered. I’m skeptical of institutions and easy answers; I need evidence. I invest carefully and don’t show off. I’m an introvert who interviews people for a living—it’s draining but I love the work. I want someone who can handle my occasional need to disappear into a book or a long run.
aboutPartner: Curious, well-read, not clingy. Someone who has their own passions and doesn’t need me to be the center of their world. Intellectual match matters.
aboutRelationship: Two independent lives that choose to overlap. Deep trust, real conversation, space when needed. I’m not looking to merge; I’m looking to add. Maybe we stay here, maybe we don’t. Flexibility over a fixed script.

name: Kobi
aboutMe: I own a small garage. I’ve lived in the same neighborhood my whole life; I know every street and most of the neighbors. I’m not spiritual—I believe in what I can fix and measure. Family is huge for me: Friday dinners, holidays, helping out. I save for my kids’ education and don’t chase luxury. I’m the guy who shows up when someone needs a lift or a hand.
aboutPartner: Grounded, family-oriented, honest. Someone who wants a simple, good life and doesn’t need flash.
aboutRelationship: For life. Marriage, kids, a home, growing old together. I want a real partner: same values, same direction, no games.

name: Dana
aboutMe: I’m a therapist in training. I’ve done a lot of inner work—therapy, meditation, some retreats—and I take emotional growth seriously. I’m an ambivert: I can lead a workshop or curl up alone. I live simply and spend on learning and health. I don’t need a big place or fancy things.
aboutPartner: Self-aware, willing to talk about feelings, not afraid of depth. Someone who’s also doing the work.
aboutRelationship: Conscious partnership. We communicate, we grow, we don’t repeat old patterns. I want safety and depth, not surface-level harmony.

name: Yaniv
aboutMe: I work in logistics and have moved five times in ten years for work. I’m used to packing light and adapting. I’m not deeply spiritual but I like silence and nature. I save aggressively because I’ve seen how fast things can change. I’m more observer than center-of-the-room; I prefer a few close friends.
aboutPartner: Adaptable, low-drama, okay with change. Someone who doesn’t need a fixed roadmap.
aboutRelationship: We figure it out as we go. I’m not promising a house in the suburbs; I’m promising presence and honesty. If we end up in one place, great. If we move, we move together.

name: Hila
aboutMe: I’m a product manager at a tech company. I’m rational, data-driven, and I don’t believe in fate or vibes—I believe in decisions and trade-offs. I’m ambitious and I invest in my career and my portfolio. I’m an extrovert at work but I need real downtime. I like running, reading non-fiction, and one or two close friends.
aboutPartner: Smart, direct, ambitious. Someone who can debate and not take it personally. No mind-reading.
aboutRelationship: Partnership like a good contract: clear, fair, both sides contributing. I want a teammate for life, with shared goals and mutual respect. Romance is nice but reliability is non-negotiable.

name: Oded
aboutMe: I’m a historian and part-time tour guide. I’ve never left this city for long; it’s in my bones. I read constantly, I’m skeptical of trends, and I don’t care about status. I’m an introvert who can perform for groups when needed. I live modestly and give to causes I trust. I want someone who gets that my passion is ideas and stories, not small talk.
aboutPartner: Curious, patient, able to listen. Someone who values depth over noise.
aboutRelationship: Quiet companionship. We don’t need to fill every silence. We share values, respect each other’s space, and build something that lasts without fanfare.

name: Noga
aboutMe: I work in hospitality and have also worked on a sailboat and in a hostel abroad. I don’t own much; I prefer experiences. I’m spiritual in a loose way—sunrise, sea, and silence mean something to me. I’m an extrovert who loves meeting new people. I’m not a planner; I follow opportunities.
aboutPartner: Free-spirited, adventurous, not tied to one place or plan.
aboutRelationship: Open. Maybe we stay, maybe we go. I want someone to share the journey with, not someone to lock into a script. Trust and fun matter more than a fixed address.

name: Erez
aboutMe: I’m a paramedic. I’ve seen life and death up close; it made me value the present and the people in it. I’m not spiritual in a religious way, but I don’t take things for granted. I’m calm under pressure and I need someone who can handle irregular hours and occasional darkness. I save but I also spend on what matters—travel, good food, time with people I love.
aboutPartner: Strong, kind, steady. Someone who doesn’t need to be rescued and can handle reality.
aboutRelationship: Real. We show up for each other, we don’t hide from hard stuff. I want a partner who’s in it for the long run, with both feet on the ground.

name: Tal
aboutMe: I’m a musician and sound designer. I work odd hours, travel for gigs, and my income is irregular. I’m not into materialism; I care about creating and connecting. I’m an ambivert: I love the stage but I need days alone to recharge. I’ve done some meditation and I believe in something bigger, but I don’t label it.
aboutPartner: Creative or at least supportive of that life. Flexible, understanding of weird schedules.
aboutRelationship: We grow together. I’m not offering stability in the classic sense—I’m offering passion, honesty, and presence. If you need a strict plan, I’m not it. If you want a real connection, I am.

name: Ruti
aboutMe: I run a small daycare and I’ve raised four kids. Family and community are my world. I’m traditional in values: commitment, loyalty, faith. I’m not into luxury; I save and spend on the kids and the home. I’m an extrovert in my community but I don’t need the outside world’s approval. I want someone who shares this life and wants to build more of it together.
aboutPartner: Same values. Serious about family, reliable, present.
aboutRelationship: Marriage and partnership for life. We’re a team: home, children, tradition, support. I’m looking for the real thing, not a trial run.
